## Problem

`docs/local-dev-env.md` (the "Validating the whole tree locally / whether detached runs are
trustworthy" section) lists the guards that misfire when another process touches the shared
checkout mid-run. It names two:

- `_no_repo_root_leaks` (`tests/conftest.py`)
- `_no_repo_commits` (`tests/conftest.py`)

It does not name the third member of the family: the session-level working-tree backstop in
`tests/conftest.py::pytest_sessionfinish`, which diffs `git status --porcelain` across the
whole session and misfires on exactly the same concurrent commit, rebase, branch switch, or
editor save. Its message has now been corrected to name that cause (bug
`inner-honourable-bluejay`), so the doc is the one remaining place a reader can look up this
guard family and not find it.

Unlike the two per-test guards, this one fires ONCE at session end rather than blaming an
arbitrary straddling test, so it deserves its own line noting the different shape: the run
tail shows a session-level REPO ISOLATION FAILURE, not an innocent test reported as errored.

## Scope

Documentation only. No code change; the guard and its message are already correct.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The bullet list in `docs/local-dev-env.md` names the `pytest_sessionfinish` working-tree
      backstop alongside the two per-test guards.
- [x] The entry states that it reports at session end rather than blaming a straddling test.
- [x] `make lint` passes.
